about.body: The Td5 is a Inline-5 (I5), 2.5L (2,498 cc), Diesel engine used across Land Rover's 2 model range, in production 1998–2006. We rebuild every Td5 to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The Td5 is fitted across Defender, Discovery — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.
